Definition: plural of Hebrew origin (H5467); Sodoma (i.e. Sedom), a place in Palestine:--Sodom.
BiblicalUsage: Sodom is the city that stands in Scripture as the example of judgment. Jesus says it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment than for the city that rejects His messengers, Luke tells how fire and brimstone rained down the day Lot went out of Sodom, and Peter says God turned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes, making them an ensample to the ungodly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sodom warns every generation the same way: God judges, and the cities He judged stand as a sign, not as a story to forget.
